opening.argument: The qualification structure requires participants to place someone in both sides of their business: “If you would like to become binary qualified you will need to put someone in the Spillover side and in the other leg of your business yourself.” It also requires “$200 in your own trading pool,” tying participation to a financial contribution. The video then directs viewers toward active enrollment through “Sign up today: https://mymticlub.com/userpanel/register.php?referral=charlieward”. These are instructions to join and build a sponsor-and-downline structure, reinforced by the closing “BULL RUN” and “THE MOVEMENT IS REAL” messaging, rather than merely an analysis of that structure.
